title: Constructible derived coefficient comparison from finite-valued to norm-continuous algebraic closure
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ different from $\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended $\ell$-adic norm topology. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. On the site of profinite sets with finite jointly surjective covers put
$$C(S)=\{a\in C(S,\Omega):a(S)\subset F\text{ for some finite intermediate field }\mathbf Q_\ell\subset F\subset\Omega\},\qquad B(S)=C(S,\Omega).$$
The ring $C$ is the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], whereas $B$ is the condensed ring of all norm-continuous functions [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Let $c:C\to B$ be the inclusion of sections. Put $C_X=p_X^*C$, $B_X=p_X^*B$, and $c_X=p_X^*c$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. For either coefficient ring, $D^b_c$ denotes the full subcategory of complexes with bounded cohomology having finite constant local models on finite constructible locally closed stratifications [sk-def-sfb-constructible].

The actual derived extension of scalars
$$J_X=B_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{C_X}-:D(\operatorname{Mod}_{C_X})\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_X})$$
[sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], computed on K-flat resolutions, restricts to an exact equivalence
$$J_X:D^b_c(X,C)\xrightarrow{\sim}D^b_c(X,B)$$
for the inherited triangulated structures. In particular it carries bounded constructible objects to bounded constructible objects, is fully faithful on that subcategory, and every bounded constructible $B_X$-complex is isomorphic to $J_XP$ for a bounded constructible $C_X$-complex $P$. This is an assertion about the specified scalar-extension functor between full subcategories of the ordinary ambient derived categories; it asserts no equivalence between the ambient categories or between $C$ and $B$, and assumes no flatness or completeness of $c_X$.

proof.text: The scalar rings $C(*)=B(*)=\Omega$ are fields, but the coefficient sheaves are retained separately. The field $k$ is Noetherian since its only ideals are zero and itself; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] makes $X$ Noetherian. Closed immersions are affine-locally quotient maps [def-weil-closed-immersion], hence finite type since each quotient algebra is generated by its unit. Composition gives finite type of closed subschemes. Opens are Noetherian and quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian], hence finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type]. Locally closed subschemes are consequently again separated finite-type $k$-schemes. We work in sheaf-module derived categories using [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison], which identifies the actual internal relative tensor and K-flat scalar extension. The functor $J_X$ is triangulated by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]; its right adjoint is the exact termwise restriction $U_X$ and its unit is scalar insertion by [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction].

source.place: Paragraph (3): schemes, ambient categories and specified scalar functor

proof.text: For any of the inclusions $A_E\to C\to B$, derived scalar extension of a lisse module is the ordinary extension, again lisse. Indeed the inverse-image comparison [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization] permits checking this on a pro-étale trivializing cover. There the calculation is $R'\otimes_R^LR^r=(R')^r$ in degree zero, including $r=0$; finite free modules are flat and their degree-zero complexes are K-flat. The explicit maps are $a\otimes(v_i)\mapsto(av_i)$ and $(w_i)\mapsto\sum_iw_i\otimes e_i$. Scalar extension also commutes with $a_!=i_*j_!$: apply the open projection formula [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization] and the closed projection formula [lem-weil-proetale-closed-tensor-projection] with the new coefficient ring as tensor factor. Closed direct image and the restrictions are exact by [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement]; all open complements here are quasi-compact. These comparisons are linear for the new ring and hence identify the new-ring modules, not only the underlying restricted modules.

source.place: Paragraph (3): scalar extension of lisse modules and supported extensions

proof.text: Let $\mathcal G_C$ consist of the objects $G=a_!(C_S\otimes^L_{A_{E,S}}L[0])$ in the new defect lemma. They generate $D^b_c(X,C)$ by finite shifts and triangle extensions. To see this, [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit] writes every object as the scalar extension of some bounded constructible $A_E$-complex. This uses precisely its finite-subextension-valued coefficient, not $B$. For that finite-stage complex, [lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage] reduces to constructible sheaves; [det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] and [det-lem-coefficient-heart-filtration] filter each such sheaf by $a_!L$ with $L$ lisse. The associated short exact sequences give triangles by [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles] in the standard heart [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], so finite induction on that filtration and on the nonzero cohomology degrees gives the asserted finite construction. Applying the exact scalar functor and Step 2 identifies every resulting generator with a member of $\mathcal G_C$. Each member is itself bounded constructible by [lem-sfb-coefficient-heart-lisse-extension-constructible] and [lem-sfb-extend-to-qlbar-constructible]. The inherited triangulated structure on the source follows from the weak-Serre assertion [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-constructible-serre] and [lem-sfb-weak-serre-bounded-thick].

source.place: Paragraph (3): finite-stage supported generators of the source

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-continuous-qbar-constructible-generators], the full bounded-constructible subcategory for the actual all-continuous ring $B$ is triangulated and is generated by supported lisse $B$-modules. Step 2 sends each $G\in\mathcal G_C$ to $a_!(B_S\otimes_{A_{E,S}}L)[0]$, which is one of these generators. Since $J_X$ is exact, applying it to the finite construction of Step 3 proves $J_X(D^b_c(X,C))\subseteq D^b_c(X,B)$. The inherited shifts and distinguished triangles therefore give the asserted exact restricted functor.

For $G,H\in\mathcal G_C$, take a distinguished triangle for the actual unit $H\xrightarrow{\eta_H}U_XJ_XH$. By [lem-sfb-supported-finite-stage-topology-defect], its third term $Q_H$ has $\operatorname{Hom}(G,Q_H[n])=0$ for every $n$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact] to all shifts and rotations of this triangle. The zero groups on either side give bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_C(G,H[n])\xrightarrow{\eta_H[n]\circ-}\operatorname{Hom}_C(G,U_XJ_XH[n])$. Under the normalized scalar adjunction [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] these are exactly $f\mapsto J_Xf$ with target $\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_XG,J_XH[n])$: the adjunct of $J_Xf$ is $U_XJ_Xf\circ\eta_G=\eta_{H[n]}\circ f$ by naturality and shift compatibility. Thus the comparison is the specified functor on morphisms.

source.place: Paragraph (3): full faithfulness on pairs of finite-stage generators

proof.text: For fixed $G\in\mathcal G_C$, let $\mathcal V_G$ be the class of source objects $H$ for which $\operatorname{Hom}_C(G,H[n])\to\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_XG,J_XH[n])$ is bijective for all $n$. It contains zero, is invariant under isomorphism and shifts, and is closed under triangle extensions: the Hom exact sequences of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact], in both ambient categories, form a commuting diagram because $J_X$ is triangulated. Choose the five consecutive terms with the unknown group in the middle; the four other comparisons are bijections, so [lem-weil-pbc-five-lemma] gives the middle bijection. Step 5 and generation in Step 3 yield every $H\in D^b_c(X,C)$. Now fix any such $H$ and repeat in the first variable with [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact], using the reversed Hom exact sequences and all shifts. Step 3 then includes every $G\in D^b_c(X,C)$. At $n=0$ this proves full faithfulness of the actual restricted $J_X$.

source.place: Paragraph (3): two finite triangle inductions give full faithfulness

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-stratified-finite-models] to a constructible $B_X$-module $M$. Obtain strata $S_a$, finite fields $E_a$ and lisse $A_{E_a,S_a}$-modules $L_a$ with $M|_{S_a}\cong B_{S_a}\otimes_{A_{E_a,S_a}}L_a$. Form $F_a=a_!L_a$ as an $A_{E_a,X}$-module; it is constructible by [lem-sfb-coefficient-heart-lisse-extension-constructible]. Take an ordered common refinement $R_t$ of all these adapted finite stratifications using [new-det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification-refinement]. It gives containment of stratum images only. For each $R_t$ choose the $S_a$ containing its image; $V_t=F_a|_{R_t}$ is lisse by [new-det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification-lisse]. To identify $M|_{R_t}$ with $B_{R_t}\otimes_{A_{E_a,R_t}}V_t$, use the actual fibre product $W=R_t\times_X S_a$. Its map $q:W\to R_t$ is a surjective closed immersion: base-change an open-then-closed factorization of $a$; the open part has all of $R_t$ as its image and so is an isomorphism. On $W$ the desired isomorphism is the pullback of the displayed model on $S_a$, using the open and closed adjunction identities of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement]. The inverse-image/scalar comparison [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization] identifies its other side with $q^*(B_{R_t}\otimes V_t)$. The pullback equivalence [new-lem-weil-pbc-condensed-surjective-closed-equivalence], applied to coefficient $B$, lifts this isomorphism to $R_t$. This proves finite-field models on the ordered refinement without assuming a morphism $R_t\to S_a$.

source.place: Paragraph (3): lift the supported pieces of a constructible target sheaf

proof.text: Put $N_t=C_{R_t}\otimes_{A_{E_a,R_t}}V_t$. Step 2 makes it lisse and gives $J_{R_t}N_t\cong M|_{R_t}$. Each $a_{t!}N_t[0]$ is bounded constructible by [lem-sfb-coefficient-heart-lisse-extension-constructible]. The successive open unions of the first ordered strata give, by the exact localization sequence of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement], a finite filtration of $M$ whose quotients are $a_{t!}(M|_{R_t})$. Its short exact sequences give triangles by [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles] in the standard heart [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Each quotient is $J_X(a_{t!}N_t[0])$ by Step 2. The essential image is closed under triangle extensions by the next step, so induction on this finite filtration proves $M[0]$ is in the image.

source.place: Paragraph (3): lift the supported pieces of a constructible target sheaf

proof.text: The essential image of this fully faithful exact functor is a full replete triangulated subcategory. To check the only nonformal point, for a map $J_XP\to J_XQ$ use fullness to write it as $J_Xu$. Choose a distinguished triangle on $u$ in the source. Exactness gives a triangle on $J_Xu$ in the target, whose third vertex is the image of the source cone; any other cone is isomorphic to it. For completeness, TR3 gives a map between the two triangles equal to the identity on the first two vertices. Apply the exact Hom sequences [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact] and [lem-weil-pbc-five-lemma] to see that this map induces bijections from every test object. Taking those test objects to be its source and target supplies a two-sided inverse. Closure under shifts and rotation then gives closure under triangle extensions. This proves the extension-lifting assertion required in Step 8.

source.place: Paragraph (3): explicit lifting of cones and extensions

proof.text: Finally apply [lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage] in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_X})$ to the essential-image property. It is isomorphism invariant and triangulated by Step 9, and it contains every constructible $B_X$-module in degree zero by Step 8. Hence it contains every bounded constructible $B_X$-complex. Together with preservation, full faithfulness and exactness, this proves the stated equivalence. An inverse chosen from the essential-surjectivity witnesses is exact: lift each morphism using full faithfulness and compare its cone with the image of a source cone as in Step 9. Empty schemes, zero sheaves, zero ranks and empty cohomological intervals all start these finite constructions at zero.

There is no repair note, the item is not dropped, and no SGA is used. Preservation (Step 4) follows from continuous-qbar-constructible-generators, which is stated for the actual all-continuous ring B, once Step 2 sends each generator to a supported lisse B-module; Step 2 rests on the χ/θ inverse-image comparison and the open (γ) and closed projection formulas. Full faithfulness (Steps 5-6): the new node's vanishing together with the Hom-into-triangle sequence gives bijections, the normalized unit and shift compatibility identify them with J_X on morphisms, and a two-variable five-lemma induction over the generators of Step 3 extends this to all objects; Step 3 uses the two-colimit for the finite-subextension ring only. Essential surjectivity (Steps 7-10): stratified finite models, the image-containment refinement handled through W=R_t×_X S_a (a surjective closed immersion, then the condensed pullback equivalence for B), the recollement filtration, extension closure of the image and module dévissage. New node lem-sfb-supported-finite-stage-topology-defect: unsplit and statement-only, self-contained, blueprint fields set. It is equivalent to the item's full-faithfulness clause on pairs of finite-stage generators only, so it follows from the item; it is not D1/D2 because Steps 3-10 do real work. Small cases: empty support or rank 0 gives zero; at X=Spec k, n=1, compact subgroups of Ω lie in a finite extension, so the two sides agree; higher n were not settled, which is exactly the content left WANTED. Batch 5: all four flagged citations are generic tools, not parts of the trace formula or Poincaré duality, so accepted: the module/ringed-topos derived comparison is a foundational identification for any condensed ring, geometric inverse image exactness is a general topos fact, def-trf-geometric-morphism is a definition, and normal Noetherian components are general topology. tool_uses accepted as written.

lean.note: The existing PadicAlgCl algebraic closure is the chosen model of Omega; its norm is the extended ell-adic norm. The finite-valued and all-continuous sheaves are distinct existing coefficient constructions. The actual inclusion and its pulled-back total left derived scalar extension are defined with real data. The theorem uses ObjectProperty.lift of this functor and asserts its IsEquivalence, both inherited triangulations, and triangulatedness of the ambient scalar functor, which gives exactness of its restriction. No flatness or completeness assumption is imposed.
